verifiedStaticProperties: Only explicitly selected apply/restore and operator1/2/3 are admitted, with active/halt markers checked before action. S/Q HEAD must equal binding source; Q index is empty.

Exact three-recipe file SHA is fixed. Apply requires clean Q and every bound S/Q byte/hash, exact original source SHA/equality, once-only match and computed expected mutant SHA. Original backup, live patch and action records are exclusively created.
Each invocation lstat-checks target regular/nlink1, exact resolved path and different inode from S target before its single target write. Action records retain the observed physical facts.

Restore requires actual phase exit1, total35/nonzero failures, no unhandled/late diagnostics, groupAbsentByESRCH, no nonzero signals and rawObserverOrderedJoin. All reported task errors must be test-kind.
The required root manual classification names exact phase/source/operator and pins the exact outcome bytes, with rootAllFailuresRead and noHookOrEnvironmentFailure true.
Restore compares current mutant with actual apply record, backup SHA with sealed original, restores exact S bytes, requires clean Q and rechecks every selected S/Q binding hash.
The helper performs no automatic restore/retry and writes no compiled/native/guard/wrapper file. Only Q target plus private exclusive evidence files are mutated.
boundedRootResponsibilities: Before helper execution, root binds actual post-count/post-build/checkpoint S/Q paths and source SHA. Prospective count hashes are not the actual future binding.

Regular-file checks are pre-write snapshots. target.write_bytes is path-based; this helper provides no atomic O_NOFOLLOW descriptor guarantee or continuous concurrent-isolation proof. Root remains sole writer/runner for the admitted fresh checkout.
Root classification is an explicit manual record, not semantic interpretation by the helper. Independent actual raw/observer/first-frame/masking review remains necessary.
The helper checks a clean Q before apply, but does not itself require the previous same-corpus restored GREEN; root serial orchestration and the later chain audit enforce that sequence.

Native identities, held R/Claude/protected bytes, frozen wrapper/observer and full preservation remain separately bound/read/check facts; only selected source/compiled bytes are checked by this helper.
wholeIssueBoundary: Pure helper source controls do not qualify actual activation, lease/approval verification, effective receipts, payment amount limits or destination effects. P1-07 strict-binding closure and all holds/quality checks stay intact.
